name: web-app-shell
description: A modern, responsive web application shell built with semantic HTML and Tailwind CSS.

scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='index.html';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Build failed: index.html missing');process.exit(1);}const h=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8');if(!h.trim()){console.error('Build failed: index.html empty');process.exit(1);}console.log('Build succeeded: index.html verified');"
scripts.test: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p='index.html';if(!fs.existsSync(p)){console.error('Test failed: index.html missing');process.exit(1);}const h=fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8').toLowerCase();const req=['<!doctype html>','<html','<head>','<body','<title>','</html>','viewport','width=device-width'];const miss=req.filter(t=>!h.includes(t));if(miss.length){console.error('Test failed: missing '+miss.join(', '));process.exit(1);}console.log('Test passed: index.html structure valid');"
scripts.start: node -e "console.log('Static site: open index.html in a browser or serve the directory.')"
